episode.title: Adapt outbound reasoning fields to a strict OpenAI-compatible endpoint
episode.before: At parent d50dc84e363f4225193418fcd8844fa21f3ae66a, provider selection had no endpoint-specific branch for api.fireworks.ai, so those configurations fell through to the default OpenAI-compatible provider. For any request whose model name contained "qwen3", that provider copied a non-empty assistant message reasoning_content value into reasoning. Replayed thinking history was therefore sent with both fields, although the target endpoint accepted reasoning_content and rejected reasoning as an extra input, causing HTTP 400 failures on multi-turn and tool-call continuations.
episode.after: At 3ba01990e13e9e8e14e147b60add50e0f972431a, configurations whose parsed hostname is api.fireworks.ai or a true subdomain select a dedicated provider. After applying normal default-provider transformations, that provider creates an outbound message array that removes reasoning only when it is a string exactly equal to reasoning_content on an assistant message. It preserves reasoning_content, distinct caller-supplied reasoning values, source conversation history, and existing behavior for other endpoints.
episode.diff: The change adds and exports a dedicated OpenAI-compatible provider, inserts hostname-based provider routing before the default fallback, and overrides request construction to reverse only the default provider's recognizable reasoning mirror at the outbound boundary. It also adds focused routing and field-preservation tests plus an HTTP integration test that exercises conversion of replayed thought history through provider request construction to a strict endpoint stand-in. Four files changed with 407 insertions.

evidence_units.claim: Commit 3ba01990 resolves issue #11657 through PR #11701 and records parent d50dc84e363f4225193418fcd8844fa21f3ae66a, four changed files, and the failure mechanism: the endpoint rejects messages[N].reasoning while accepting reasoning_content.

In the parent state, the default provider recognized model names containing qwen3 and mapped assistant messages through mirrorReasoningContentToReasoning, which copied a non-empty reasoning_content string into reasoning when reasoning was not already a string.
The provider selector gained a branch before the default fallback that constructs the dedicated provider when its endpoint predicate matches.

Endpoint recognition parses baseUrl, lowercases the URL hostname, accepts the exact canonical hostname or dot-delimited subdomains, and returns false for absent or malformed URLs; it deliberately does not route by model name.
The endpoint-specific provider first invokes default request construction, then maps the resulting messages through an unmirroring operation without modifying the input request object.

Unmirroring applies only to assistant messages and removes reasoning only when it is a string equal to reasoning_content; non-assistant messages, unequal values, and non-string values are returned unchanged.
The request pipeline invokes provider.buildRequest after constructing the base request and before request capture and SDK execution, making the provider hook an outbound wire-shape boundary.

Conversation conversion serializes model thought parts into assistant reasoning_content before provider request construction, establishing how replayed thinking history reaches the mirroring and unmirroring logic.

Focused tests verify removal of the mirrored field while preserving reasoning_content and source history, recognition of a legitimate subdomain, rejection of a hostile suffix hostname, preservation of a distinct explicit reasoning value, and unchanged mirroring for a non-matching endpoint.

An HTTP strict-endpoint stand-in rejects any assistant reasoning field with a 400-shaped response; the end-to-end test sends an initial turn and a replayed-thinking continuation through the real generator/converter/provider path, receives successful responses, and asserts that reasoning_content but not reasoning reached the wire.
The new provider is exported from the provider barrel and the public openaiContentGenerator module, making it available to the selector and direct construction used by integration tests.

candidate_atomics.name: Route an endpoint-specific adapter by canonical hostname
candidate_atomics.description: Select the compatibility adapter from a parsed, boundary-safe endpoint hostname rather than from a hosted model-family name that can also appear on unrelated services.

semantic_action.intent: Apply endpoint-specific wire rules only to requests actually targeting the incompatible service.
semantic_action.pre_state: The endpoint configuration falls through to a generic compatible provider, while model identity alone cannot prove which service receives the request.
semantic_action.post_state: Exact canonical hosts and true subdomains select the endpoint adapter; malformed URLs and lookalike suffix hosts retain generic routing.
semantic_action.validation: Selection tests cover the canonical host, a true subdomain, a hostile hostname containing the canonical text, and a different endpoint hosting the same model family.

candidate_atomics.name: Remove only a synthesized duplicate field at the outbound boundary
candidate_atomics.description: Run the generic request transformation first, then immutably remove the incompatible field only when its value proves it is the exact synthesized copy of the accepted field.

semantic_action.intent: Prevent strict compatible endpoints from rejecting replayed reasoning history without discarding supported reasoning data or caller intent.
semantic_action.pre_state: A generic transformation has added reasoning beside reasoning_content for assistant messages in a model-family request, and the target endpoint rejects the additional field.
semantic_action.post_state: Outbound assistant messages omit only string-valued reasoning entries equal to reasoning_content; reasoning_content and distinct explicit reasoning values remain, and the source history is unchanged.
semantic_action.validation: Unit tests inspect the normalized request and original request, assert preservation of a distinct explicit value, and assert unchanged behavior outside the routed endpoint.

candidate_atomics.name: Validate continuation against a strict endpoint contract
candidate_atomics.description: Exercise the complete history-conversion and outbound-adaptation path against a local endpoint that rejects the forbidden wire shape and inspect the accepted request body.

semantic_action.intent: Prove that replayed thinking history can continue successfully under the target endpoint's strict input schema.
semantic_action.pre_state: A multi-turn request contains a prior model thought that conversion represents as reasoning_content, and the endpoint rejects any assistant reasoning property.
semantic_action.post_state: Both turns succeed; the continuation carries reasoning_content on the wire and carries no reasoning property.
semantic_action.validation: The local HTTP stand-in returns HTTP 400 whenever an assistant reasoning key is present; the integration test completes two generator calls and asserts the captured follow-up body has reasoning_content but no reasoning.

candidate_workflows.name: Adapt a generic compatible request shape to a stricter endpoint
candidate_workflows.description: When a service implementing a nominally compatible API rejects a field synthesized by generic provider logic, identify that service from trustworthy endpoint identity, reconcile the request at the last provider-owned boundary, preserve supported and caller-authored data, and validate both strict acceptance and non-target behavior.

workflow_graph.goal: Allow replayed reasoning and tool-call continuations to reach a strict compatible endpoint without schema rejection or collateral changes to other endpoints and explicit fields.
workflow_graph.entry_state: Generic model-family processing synthesizes an additional message field that the configured endpoint does not accept, causing continuations containing replayed thought history to fail.
workflow_graph.exit_state: The affected endpoint is safely routed through an immutable outbound adapter; only the recognizable synthesized duplicate is absent from the wire; accepted reasoning history, explicit distinct fields, source history, and other endpoints' behavior remain intact; a strict integration oracle accepts the continuation.

unresolved_questions: Was api.fireworks.ai the complete production hostname set requiring this adapter? The implementation and tests establish exact-host and subdomain behavior, but the unavailable issue and PR discussion may have contained additional deployment context.

The repository working tree at inspection time was not usable for an independent test run; validation claims are therefore limited to direct inspection of the committed test implementation and its strict endpoint oracle.
